cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content Editor position at Evolutionary Archetypes Consulting SL. Your work across EU funds, business consulting, technical communication and e-learning calls for content that is precise, well-researched and readable. That is the kind of work I do, and I'd like to do it with you.

At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, and I manage CMS content in WordPress: publishing and updating pages, blog posts and media, and keeping existing content current. I also build and maintain sites directly, including majistraleczacilari.org.tr, a pharmacists' association site where I created a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages. That project required steady attention to detail and a reliable editorial structure, not just writing.

Before that, at Knowledge Experts, I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace projects for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. Working on those systems taught me how technical content has to be exact, and how to research a subject properly before writing a single line. I also have a front-end development background, which helps me work confidently with web content and the people who build it.

I write in fluent English, use AI tools daily for research, drafting and editing, and I'm used to remote, deadline-driven work. I respect the values the EU stands for and would be glad to contribute to content that helps organizations access EU funding.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your editorial work.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
